{< include ../exercise-header.qmd >}


::: {#exr-reptile-sell-pencil}


MAKE THIS INTO A SIMULATION of many cars based on a simulated assumption of an accident rate of 2 accidents per million miles. How much data is needed to estimate the rate in a way that would support a claim that self-driving cars are safer.
(REMEMBER, this is simulated data. )


The experiment starts. After about a year, we have collected some data. (See `r xf("tbl-car-crash-table")`.)
